```{r}
result.dir <- "../../results/07_DGE/Final_results/tables/"
top30.table <- file.path(
  paste0(result.dir, "top30_cpgs_eqtms_gex.csv")
)

df.top30 <- read_csv(top30.table)
df.top30
```



```{r}
# Load packages

library(RCy3)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)  # for human gene annotation
library(enrichplot)
library(ReactomePA)

# If you have gene names and need to convert to Entrez IDs
gene.ids.entrez <- bitr(
  df.top30$gene.symbol,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

nr.map.entrez.id <- unique(gene.ids.entrez$SYMBOL)
nr.genes.to.use <- unique(df.top30$gene.symbol)
total.to.use <- base::intersect(nr.genes.to.use, nr.map.entrez.id)

print("")
print(
  paste0("Total genes to use in enrichment: ", length(total.to.use))
)
```


```{r}
res.dir.functional <- "../../results/07_DGE/cluster_profiler/"
# Create the main GO results directory
GO.result.dir <- file.path(res.dir.functional, "functional_analysis/GO_plots") 
dir.create(GO.result.dir, recursive = TRUE)


# Define the vector of ontology types
ontology_types <- c("BP", "MF", "CC")

# Loop through each ontology type
for (ont_type in ontology_types) {
  
  cat("Processing ontology:", ont_type, "\n")
  
   
  go_enrichment <- enrichGO(
    gene = gene.ids.entrez$ENTREZID,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,  # Relaxed from 0.05
    qvalueCutoff = 0.05,  # Relaxed from 0.05
    keyType = "ENTREZID",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",  # Try Benjamini-Hochberg instead of FDR
    ont = ont_type,
    minGSSize = 5,       # Lower minimum gene set size
    maxGSSize = 500      # Ensure you're not excluding small categories
  )
  
  # Check if enrichment results exist
  if (nrow(go_enrichment@result) > 0) {
    
    # Create the dotplot
    p <- dotplot(go_enrichment, showCategory = 30) + 
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
      ggtitle(paste("GO Enrichment -", ont_type))
    
    # Create filename with the ontology type
    filename <- file.path(GO.result.dir, paste0("dotplot_GO_", ont_type, ".png"))
    
    # Save the plot
    ggsave(
      filename = filename,
      plot = p,
      width = 8, 
      height = 15,
      dpi = 300,
      units = "in"
    )
    
    cat("Saved plot for", ont_type, "to:", filename, "\n")
    
  } else {
    cat("No significant enrichment found for", ont_type, "\n")
  }
}

cat("GO enrichment analysis completed for all ontology types.\n")
```



```{r}
# Perform KEGG pathway enrichment analysis
kegg_enrichment <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = gene.ids.entrez$ENTREZID,
  keyType = 'ncbi-geneid',
  organism = "hsa",
  pAdjustMethod = "none",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.1,
  )  # "hsa" for human

# View results
head(kegg_enrichment, n=50)
```

```{r}
KEGG.result.dir <- file.path(res.dir.functional, "functional_analysis/KEGG_plots") 
dir.create(KEGG.result.dir, recursive=TRUE)

# KEGG pathway bar plot
p <- barplot(kegg_enrichment, showCategory = 10, title = "Top 10 KEGG Pathways")


filename <- file.path(KEGG.result.dir, "barplot_kegg_top10cpg.png")
ggsave(
  filename = filename,   
  plot = p,                               
  width = 8, height = 10,                  
  dpi = 300,                              
  units = "in"                            
)

```

```{r}
REACT.result.dir <- file.path(res.dir.functional, "functional_analysis/REACTOME_plots") 
dir.create(REACT.result.dir, recursive=TRUE)


# Perform Reactome pathway enrichment analysis
reactome_enrichment <- enrichPathway(
  gene = gene.ids.entrez$ENTREZID,
  organism = "human",
  pAdjustMethod = "fdr",
  qvalueCutoff = 0.1,
  readable = TRUE
  )

# View results
head(as.data.frame(reactome_enrichment))
```

```{r}
# Reactome enrichment map
p<- barplot(reactome_enrichment, showCategory = 10, title = "Top Reactome Pathways")


# Customize the plot (reduce size of y-axis labels)
library(ggplot2)
customized_bar_plot <- p +
  theme_minimal() +                                    # Change theme
  labs(x = "Pathways", y = "-log10(Adjusted p-value)") + # Update axis labels
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # Rotate x-axis labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),               # Reduce size of y-axis labels
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold") # Center the title
  )

# View the customized plot
print(customized_bar_plot)

# Save the plot to a file
filename <- file.path(REACT.result.dir, "barplot_REACTOME_top10.png")

ggsave(filename, 
       plot = customized_bar_plot, 
       width = 10, height = 6, units = "in")
```


```{r}
filename <- file.path(REACT.result.dir, "heatplot_REACTOME_top10_categories.png")
png(filename, width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
heatplot(reactome_enrichment, showCategory = 20, foldChange = NULL)
dev.off()

```
